compute.cost_note: stdlib function-word distance; one feature pass per text and baseline file

do_not_use_when: you lack trustworthy controls; mislabeled controls invert the frame
the baseline contains the questioned text or a control; overlapping entries are dropped and an emptied baseline is refused
you want a verdict that the questioned text is authentic or smoothed; the output only says which pole is nearer

examples.description: Questioned draft between an authentic and a smoothed control

inputs.target: questioned text plus negative and/or positive control files and a baseline (--baseline-dir or --manifest)

purpose: Negative and positive controls for voice distance. Computes the function-word distance to the same baseline for the questioned text, a known-authentic negative control and a known-smoothed positive control, and reports the three side by side with which pole the questioned text sits nearer. A comparison frame, not a classifier.
use_when: you have an untouched earlier text and a known AI-edited or heavily copyedited text by the same writer and want a readable comparison frame
explaining a voice_distance number to a non-technical reader
